title: Completion comparison from a supplied normalized restriction functor
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I$ an ideal, and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Put $X_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(A)}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ [def-pc-base-change], $j_n:X_n\to X$, and $J=I\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal]. Coherent modules are in the sense of [pqf-def-coherent], and powers of ideal sheaves are as in [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. Assume $X$ is Noetherian, $j_n$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with kernel $J^{n+1}$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and let $i_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ satisfy both pullback projection identities, including the quotient factor map on the second projection. Specify adjunctions $a_i:i_n^*\dashv i_{n,*}$ and $a_j:j_n^*\dashv j_{n,*}$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Given any functor $\Phi:\mathrm{Sys}(X_n,i_n)\to\mathit{Coh}(X,J)$ with natural evaluation isomorphisms $\beta_n:(\Phi M)_n\cong j_{n,*}M_n$ whose adjacent transitions are the pushed adjoints of the comparisons, suppose natural composition comparisons $c_n:j_{n+1}^*i_n^*\cong j_n^*$, a functor $R:\mathit{Coh}(X)\to\mathrm{Sys}(X_n,i_n)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-thickening-system], and natural evaluations $r_n:(RF)_n\cong j_n^*F$ are given. Suppose the $c_n$ identify the composite units of $a_j$ and $a_i$ with the units of $a_j$ at level $n$, and the comparison maps of $R$ agree with $c_n$ under $r_n$. Then there exists a natural isomorphism $\rho:\operatorname{completion}\cong R\Phi$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], whose component at $F,n$, followed by $\beta_{n,RF}$ and $j_{n,*}(r_{n,F})$, carries the quotient projection $F\to F/J^{n+1}F$ precisely to the unit $a_{j_n,F}$. No construction of $c,R,r$ is asserted; these are supplied data. No equivalence of $\Phi$, completeness, separatedness, or support assertion is assumed.

proof.text: For each coherent F and n apply closedImmersion_power_quotient to j_n with ker(j_n)=J^(n+1) and the supplied adjunction aj_n. Compose this quotient isomorphism with the inverse pushforward of r_n and inverse beta_n to define e(F,n). Its composite with beta_n and pushed r_n sends the quotient projection to aj_n.unit.

Prove restriction_transition as a private general categorical lemma: use naturality of the composition pushforward isomorphism, adjunction units, and the supplied comparison equation hr to transport the pushed adjoint comparison to the composite normalized unit. Apply hc. Cancel beta_n followed by pushed r_n to obtain compatibility of quotient projections with adjacent transitions. Cancel the epi quotient projection and induct on b <= a to get every transition square.

For a coherent module map, cancel the source cokernel projection and the target beta/r isomorphism. Naturality of beta, r and the adjunction unit proves the component naturality equation. Assemble the level isomorphisms by NatIso.ofComponents, lift them using ObjectProperty.isoMk, and assemble the natural isomorphism of functors by NatIso.ofComponents again. The previously proved normalized component equation is exactly the conclusion.

proof_origin.note: Lean proof by V3: the single-immersion quotient step is split off; all transition compatibility, naturality, induction and full-subcategory assembly are proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem completion_from_restriction {A : Type v} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {X : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (I : Ideal A)
    (i : ∀ n : ℕ, pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ⟶
        pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))
    (hi : ∀ n : ℕ,
      i n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))) =
          pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))
    (hi₂ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      i n ≫ pullback.snd f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))) =
      pullback.snd f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := I) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
    (ai : ∀ n : ℕ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward (i n))
    (aj : ∀ n : ℕ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) ⊣
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (I ^ (n + 1)))))))
    [hX : IsNoetherian X]
    (hgeom : (∀ n : ℕ, IsClosedImmersion (pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (I ^ (n + 1)))))) ∧
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))).ker =
            (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
            A)).inv.hom)).comap f ^ (n + 1)))
    (Φ : CoherentThickeningSystem (fun n ↦ pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) i ⥤
          @CoherentFormalModule X hX ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso
              (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f))
        (β : ∀ n : ℕ,
          Φ ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsCoherentFormalModule ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map
              (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)) ⋙
            (CategoryTheory.evaluation ℕᵒᵖ X.Modules).obj (op n) ≅
          CoherentThickeningSystem.evaluation (fun n ↦ pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) i n ⋙
            Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))))
    (htransition : (∀ (M : CoherentThickeningSystem (fun n ↦ pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) i) (n : ℕ),
          (((Φ.obj M).obj).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) ≫ (β n).hom.app M =
          (β (n + 1)).hom.app M ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))).map
              ((ai n).homEquiv _ _ (M.comparison n).hom) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (i n) (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))).hom.app
              (M.term n) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (hi n)).hom.app (M.term n)))
    (c : ∀ n : ℕ,
            Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) ⋙
              Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ≅
            Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))))
    (R : CoherentModules X ⥤ CoherentThickeningSystem (fun n ↦ pullback f (Spec.map
              (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) i)
          (r : ∀ n : ℕ, R ⋙ CoherentThickeningSystem.evaluation (fun n ↦ pullback f (Spec.map
              (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) i n ≅
            ObjectProperty.ι (RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace) ⋙
              Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                  (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))))
    (hc : ∀ (F : X.Modules) (n : ℕ),
            (aj (n + 1)).unit.app F ≫
              (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                  (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))).map
                ((ai n).unit.app
                  ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))).obj F)) ≫
              (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (i n) (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                  (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))).hom.app
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).obj
                  ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))).obj F)) ≫
              (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (hi n)).hom.app
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).obj
                  ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))).obj F)) ≫
              (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                  (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).map ((c n).hom.app F) =
            (aj n).unit.app F)
    (hr : ∀ (F : CoherentModules X) (n : ℕ),
            ((R.obj F).comparison n).hom ≫ (r n).hom.app F =
              (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).map ((r (n + 1)).hom.app F) ≫
                (c n).hom.app F.obj) :
    ∃ (ρ : @completion X hX ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso
              (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f) ≅ R ⋙ Φ),
          (∀ (F : CoherentModules X) (n : ℕ),
            formalModuleQuotientπ ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso
                (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f) (n + 1) F.obj ≫
              (ρ.hom.app F).hom.app (op n) ≫ (β n).hom.app (R.obj F) ≫
                (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).map ((r n).hom.app F) =
            (aj n).unit.app F.obj)
